title.zh: 将 Sorsogon 省 Pilar 市镇一所中学的附属校分离，改设为独立的 Salvacion 国立中学并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Salvacion High School Annex in the Municipality of Pilar, Province of Sorsogon, From the Pilar Productivity High School, and Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Salvacion National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu của Trường Trung học Salvacion tại Đô thị Pilar, Tỉnh Sorsogon khỏi Trường Trung học Pilar Productivity và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Salvacion Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขตของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Salvacion ในเทศบาล Pilar จังหวัด Sorsogon ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pilar Productivity และยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Salvacion แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Salvacion di Kotamadya Pilar, Provinsi Sorsogon dari Sekolah Menengah Pilar Productivity dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Salvacion Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Salvacion di Perbandaran Pilar, Wilayah Sorsogon daripada Sekolah Menengah Pilar Productivity dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Salvacion Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Salvacion High School Annex in Barangay Salvacion in the Municipality of Pilar, Province of Sorsogon, is hereby separated from the Pilar Productivity High School in the Municipality of Pilar, and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Salvacion National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports (DECS) shall issue rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Salvacion High School Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Salvacion National High School.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Pilar Productivity Development High School-Salvacion Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Salvacion National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act,
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
